versions.changelog: Add featured_list tool (51st): Wikipedia's Featured List of the day, with optional YYYYMMDD date browsing. Server 1.1.42.
New most_linked tool (50th): most-referenced articles ranked by incoming links, article-namespace only.
New template_usage tool (49th): which articles transclude a given template. Schema honesty fix: template now declared required.
Add wanted_articles tool (48th tool): most-wanted missing articles ranked by incoming-link demand, with template-cluster collapsing.
Add article_at_date tool (47th tool): the time machine — returns an article's lead text as it read on any date.
Add article_path tool (46th tool): six-degrees path finder — shortest chain of links between two articles, 1-3 hops, bidirectional and redirect-aware
Add citation_sources tool (45th tool): source-diversity map of an article's references — ranked publisher table, diversity verdict, archived-copy and scholarly DOI shares
Add article_pulse tool (44th tool): article vital signs — creation date and creator, length, watcher count, last edit, 30-day velocity with verdict
Add article_protection tool (43rd tool): page protection status with plain-language levels, expiry dates, redirect chains, and salted-title detection
Add article_flags tool (42nd tool): article maintenance banners with plain-language meanings. Server 1.1.31.
Adds talk tool (41st tool): active discussion threads on an article's talk page, ranked by last activity. Server 1.1.30. All 578 tests passed.
README: generic MCP client setup first (any client, not just OpenClaw); server 1.1.29, 40 tools.
Adds citation_needed (40th tool): finds statements Wikipedia editors flagged as unsourced, per-article with tag dates or topic-wide. Server 1.1.29.
Identical to 1.6.16 (simple_summary tool, server 1.1.28). Corrects the source-commit metadata on 1.6.16, which pointed at a wrong hash.
Add simple_summary tool (39th tool): plain-language explanations from Simple English Wikipedia. Server version 1.1.28.
Add user_contribs tool (38th tool): recent contributions by a username or IP with registration date and edit count. Server version 1.1.27.
Add disambiguation tool: structured candidate list for ambiguous titles (37 tools total)
Add revision_diff tool: plain-text unified diff between two article revisions (36 tools total). Note: 1.6.12 was skipped due to a registry write conflict.
Add revision_diff tool: plain-text unified diff between two article revisions (36 tools total)
New section_text tool: read one article section as plain text (by number, hierarchical number, or heading name). 35 tools total.

New references tool: returns the article's numbered reference list — each citation's cleaned text plus off-wiki source URLs (DOI, publisher, archive). Verification companion to external_links. 470 tests passing, 34 tools total.
New contributors tool: ranked top editors of an article (33rd tool)

- Added new tool: `related_articles` for retrieving Wikipedia articles similar to a given article.
- Updated documentation to include usage examples and a description of the new `related_articles` feature.
- Removed outdated skill-card.md file.
- Minor documentation edits and adjustments to reflect new capabilities.

- Added new tool: media_of_the_day — fetches Wikimedia Commons' Media of the Day (video/audio clip) for a given date.
- Updated documentation and usage examples to include media_of_the_day.
- No breaking changes to existing tools; all previous functions remain unchanged.
New births_on_this_day tool: notable births from Wikipedia's On This Day feed, completing the today-in-history trio (events, births, deaths). 30 tools total.
New article_quality tool: Wikipedia WikiProject quality grades and importance ratings via the read-only pageassessments API.
New media_search tool: keyword search of Wikimedia Commons (images/video/audio) by topic. Complement to image and media_list tools.
New infobox tool: structured fact-box extraction from article infoboxes (repo v1.1.17)
New category_members tool: list Wikipedia articles filed under a category (reverse of categories), each with a 1-2 sentence extract and thumbnail. Repo version 1.1.16.
Tool description improvements for search, summary, random, and featured_article: concrete behavior details, examples, and cross-tool usage guidance (Glama tool-score feedback). Repo version 1.1.15.
Add recent_changes tool: live Wikipedia edit activity (filter by edit/new/categorize/log, multi-language, diff links). Bumps to 25 tools.
Add picture_of_the_day tool: Wikimedia Commons' curated daily image (thumbnail, photographer, license, description, full-size + file links). Optional YYYYMMDD date and lang params.
Adds two new tools: nearby (location-based article discovery by title or lat/lon) and external_links (off-wiki citations and references an article points to). 23 tools total.
Restored display title to 'Wikipedia MCP'. No code changes since 1.3.0 (revisions tool release).
New revisions tool: article edit history with diff links, editors, summaries, and byte-size deltas (tool #21). Published from evanfoglia/wikipedia-mcp master.

Add backlinks (what-links-here via prop=linkshere), deaths_on_this_day (notable deaths for today's UTC date, companion to on_this_day), and translations (all language editions via prop=langlinks). 20 tools total.

feat: add article_sections tool (PR #17) — returns the table of contents (section headings, numbers, nesting level) for a Wikipedia article via the MediaWiki parse API `prop=sections` endpoint. Indents nested sections by 2 spaces per `toclevel`. Handles `missingtitle` / 'doesn't exist' / 'Bad title' errors with consistent 'Article not found' message. Pairs naturally with `summary` (lead + thumbnail), `article_sections` (structure), `article_extract` (full body). 17 tools total, 210/210 tests pass per cron (+13 new article_sections tests; local test run hit a time-dependent `top_reads` flake because cron ran at 09:05 EDT Sep 4 but my local run was at 21:29 EDT — Wikipedia top-reads data lags 1-2 days for the current UTC day, unrelated to the new tool).

feat: add media_list tool (PR #16) — returns every media item (images/videos/audio) used in a Wikipedia article via the REST `/page/media-list` endpoint. Complements `image` (lead thumbnail only) with structured per-item metadata: file title, type (image/video/audio), caption, thumbnail URL, plus a 🏆 marker on the lead. `limit` clamps 1-100, default 25. Protocol-relative URLs (`//upload.wikimedia.org/...`) upgraded to `https://` for MCP client compatibility. 16 tools total, 197/197 tests pass (+20 new media_list tests).

feat: add quote tool (PR #15) — returns a random notable quote (author + attribution) from a curated list of 23 famous authors (Churchill, Einstein, Twain, Gandhi, Mandela, Wilde, Angelou, Jobs, Lennon, Socrates, Plato, Aristotle, Jane Austen, etc.). Same curated-list pattern as `dino_fact`'s DINOS list — no scraping fragility. Pairs with `did_you_know` (random encyclopedia fact) and `dino_fact` (random dino fact) for daily trivia variety. Lang param accepted for API consistency but currently English-only. 15 tools total, 177/177 tests pass (+12 new quote tests).

feat: add image tool (PR #14) — returns lead image (thumbnail + original-resolution URL + dimensions + credit when available) for a Wikipedia article via the MediaWiki Action API `prop=pageimages`. Pairs with `summary` (small inline thumbnail) and `article_extract` (no images). 14 tools total, 144/144 tests pass (+12 new image tests).

feat: add top_reads tool — most-viewed articles on Wikipedia for a given date. Backed by the Wikimedia 'most read' per-day endpoint, returns ranked list with article + views + rank. Optional `lang` (default 'en') and `date` (default yesterday UTC, YYYY-MM-DD). 13 tools total, 132/132 tests pass.

feat: add news tool — current events from Wikipedia Main Page 'In the news' section. Parses editorially-curated current-events feed into Markdown with bold + linked article titles. Limit 1-10 (default 5), language via `lang`. 12 tools total, 103/103 tests pass.

feat: add pageviews tool — daily view counts for any Wikipedia article over a date range via Wikimedia's pageviews REST API (cross-wiki metric, hosted on wikimedia.org). Default window = last 7 days ending yesterday UTC. Returns total + daily average + markdown table. 11 tools total, 102/102 tests pass.

feat: add links tool — outgoing Wikipedia article links (graph-style discovery from a known article, main namespace). Pairs with categories for taxonomy + graph discovery. 10 tools total, 86/86 tests pass.
feat: add article_extract tool (full plain-text article extract via MediaWiki Action API) + add categories tool (list Wikipedia categories an article belongs to). 9 tools total, 73/73 tests pass.
feat: add on_this_day tool — historical events for today's date (51/51 tests pass)

1.1.2 — fix: search_wikipedia handles non-integer limit input (clamp + type safety); test coverage for _call_tool dispatch routing, _base/_wiki lang validation, get_summary empty/whitespace titles, search_wikipedia limit clamping. No public API changes.
v1.1.1 — re-attempt after stuck 1.1.0 publish (CLI/server desync bug). multi-language (10 wikis), featured_article tool, 16/16 tests, dead code removed, dino_fact now falls back to random dino.

- Removed LICENSE, README.md, and tests/test_server.py files.
- No functional changes to the Wikipedia skill; documentation and test code have been cleaned up.

Modernize v1.1.0 — multi-language (10 wikis), featured_article tool, 16-test smoke suite, fallback dino when species missing, fixed User-Agent, removed dead code, added .gitignore. Bumps protocol to 2025-06-18.
